title: feat(types)!: an authored object-gantt takes its props in the spec's properties bag; the flat spelling is refused by name (objectui#10859, batch 6)
body:
Part of #10859
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, copied from the PM claim `5924906396`: `@object-ui/types`' authoring faces widen (a spec-shaped `object-gantt` bag node that is refused today parses) and narrow (a flat `object-gantt` node that parses today is refused). This is objectui's narrowing-as-`minor` rule with a **BREAKING (authoring)** banner in the changeset, as in batches 1 to 5.

Batch 6 of objectui#10859, the last flat-arm block. It executes seat 1's flat-arm answer at PR objectui#11248's ACCEPT (`5917261346`) for ONE block, `object-gantt`, following batch 5 (PR objectui#11309) as merged with PR objectui#11312 (one `requireRecordSource(type, rungs, at)`; the cross-seat pointer `5924134305`). The card stays open for the designer six and the (ii) / (iii) keys.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: new `ObjectGanttBlockSchema`, batch 5's construct. It is `BaseSchema` + the `object-gantt` literal + `NODE_ENVELOPE` + `properties = propsBag('object-gantt', stripImportedDefaults(SpecObjectGanttPropsSchema))`: the shared helpers and the installed 17.5.0 row by reference, no copy, no new helper. Beside it:
  - `dataSource`, the spec's `ElementDataSourceSchema` by reference (the registration is `elementDataSourceBlock`-wrapped);
  - one `aliasKeyRefusal` per member of the row, keyed by the row's own key set read off the crossed row ("Did you mean `KEY` → `properties.KEY`?"), **less `label`** (see Deviations);
  - one `aliasKeyRefusal` per member of the row's `gantt` block, pointed at `properties.gantt.KEY`, plus the flat mirror's legacy `dependencyField` pointed at `properties.gantt.dependenciesField`. These are the flat `GanttConfig` keys the flat mirror declared on the node;
  - `body` / `children` refused with the flat mirror's objectui#9256 string;
  - the maintainer's record-source rule read in the bag through the merged `requireRecordSource('object-gantt', RECORD_SOURCE_KEYS, 'properties')`. It counts a non-empty `dataSource.object`, so a bag node bound only through `dataSource` parses on both faces.
- The arm joins `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`. `ObjectGanttSchema` (the flat mirror) leaves `ObjectQLComponentSchema` (9 to 8 arms), stays exported, and stays paired with its TypeScript twin in the parity census. Its docblock gains a "No longer an authoring arm" section.
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the TypeScript `ObjectGanttSchema` is **re-declared, not retired**. Its members are unchanged; its docblock says it is the node as `ObjectGantt` reads it after `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties`, and as code composes it. The TypeScript union's docblock names the zod union's new count.
- `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` (one barrel export) and `packages/types/src/zod/README.md` (the ObjectQL public-block group lists the arm, 7).
- objectui's authored flat producers, rewritten to the bag (census below): `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx`, the three `examples/schema-catalog` gantt entries, `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md`.
- New pins: `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-gantt-properties-bag-10859-b6.test.ts` (both faces, the row by reference, the flat keys, the record source, the split) and `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.propertiesBag-10859.test.tsx` (render through the real registry).
- Two changesets: `.changeset/10859-object-gantt-properties-bag.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, BREAKING (authoring) banner) and `.changeset/10859-plugin-gantt-properties-bag-docs.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-gantt` patch: README and the two touched `src/` test files; no runtime change).

**Files beyond the claimed surface**, each forced:
- census rows the new export forces: `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (one `EXCLUSIONS` row; `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` untouched), `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` (one `IMPORTED` row), `registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts` (the exact literal list gains `object-gantt`), `objectql-union-arms-7363.test.ts` (8 arms, `object-gantt` not among them), `public-block-responsive-styles-10872.test.ts` (`object-gantt` joins `DECLARES_DATA_SOURCE` and the record-source carve-out);
- fixture triage where a face now judges the bag (the mirror rows keep the post-hoist spelling): `content-channel-e3-residual-9256.test.ts`, `objectql-record-source-refinement-6939.test.ts`, `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts`, the schema-catalog `objectql-record-source-render-identity-6939.test.tsx` (its anti-vacuity row reads the bag; its PRE_REPAIR render readings hold unchanged) and plugin-gantt's `ObjectGantt.catalogPlans-11141.test.tsx` (it mounts `ObjectGantt` directly, so it hoists the catalog bag the way `SchemaRenderer` does).

## Zone 1, measured before building

1. **The inherited reason holds for this arm.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0: `ComponentPropsMap['object-gantt']` exists and is the exported `ObjectGanttPropsSchema` (17 members, strict; its `gantt` member is the 29-key `GanttConfig`). `PageComponentSchema` refuses `{ type: 'object-gantt', objectName, gantt }` with `unrecognized_keys ['objectName', 'gantt']` ("Unrecognized key(s) on this page component … ADR-0089 D3a") and accepts the same props in `properties`. A flat `startDateField` is refused the same way. Control: a flat `action:button` `actionType` is refused the same way. The row exists, so the bag is that row by reference (no mirror bag, unlike `object-chart`).
2. **Census, with the stop line.** At base `5262f7dd3`, 138 tracked files name `object-gantt`: 11 `CHANGELOG.md`, 27 pending changesets, 77 test files and 23 others:

| class | files | action |
|:--|:--|:--|
| authored page-node producers | `plugin-gantt.mdx` (10 nodes and the Schema API block), the 3 schema-catalog entries, `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md` (8 nodes) | rewritten |
| component mounts (post-hoist `schema` prop, no hoist) | `plugin-gantt.mdx` "Task Click", README "Interactive Gantt" and "Integration with Data Sources" | kept flat, now said so |
| runtime composers | `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx` (flatten a stored gantt view, write the flat `GanttConfig` keys and the `search` pair) | kept flat; they render through `SchemaRenderer` and never meet the zod faces |
| the declarations | `objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts` | this change |
| renderer and registration | `ObjectGantt.tsx`, `plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`, `register-plugins.ts` | none |
| names the type, no node shape | `known-schema-types.ts`, `public-blocks.ts`, `record-source.ts`, comments (`ValueDataSource.ts`, `plugin-tree/src/index.tsx`, `registerCatalogBlocks.ts`), two `scripts/check-*` ledgers, prose (`component.prompt.md`, `data-source.md`) | none |
| governed `skills/**` | `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` "Gantt plugin example" (one flat node, plus prose teaching the flat field keys on the node) | **listed, not rewritten** (governed path) |

   **Stop line: not tripped.** No objectui context builds anything from the zod `ObjectGanttSchema` object: its only non-test reader was the `ObjectQLComponentSchema` union, and that union's only reader is `AnyComponentSchema`. The non-page contexts that keep the flat spelling depend on the TypeScript twin (the composers, `ObjectGantt`'s `schema` prop) or on the registration's `inputs` (the sdui-parser html tier), not on that object.
3. **The arm**, as above. `ObjectGanttSchema` is re-declared, not retired.
4. **Producers**: rewritten as above; one governed producer listed.
5. **Pins**: below. The objectui#10859 ratchet does not move: `object-gantt` was never refused at `type`.

**Batch 5's finding, re-measured.** On base, `safeValidateSchema` already accepts the flat `{ type: 'object-gantt', dataSource: { object: 'task' }, gantt }` (PR objectui#11312 counts the binding on every arm), so the finding no longer reproduces on the flat arm. For the bag arm it is answered: a `dataSource`-only bag node parses on both faces (pinned), and `dataSource: { object: '' }` with no rung is refused.

## Zone 2, re-measured

1. Held: each symbol is where the order located it at `5262f7dd3`.
2. Held: 23 non-test, non-changelog, non-changeset files name `object-gantt` (table above).
3. Held: no open PR edits these regions. PR objectui#11333 also edits `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts`; `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against its head `139a49137` exits 0, and against `origin/main` `5262f7dd3` exits 0.

## Tests (heavy runs through `os-verify-lock.sh`, slot `issue-10859`)

- **Base measurement** (source, before any edit): the bag node `{ type: 'object-gantt', properties: { objectName, gantt } }` refused by `safeValidateSchema` (`RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at the root) and by the strict face (the same, plus `unrecognized_keys ['properties']`); the flat node accepted on both.
- **Green, union at the final head `0c673ccb8`:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/cli/ scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files 510 passed | 2 skipped (512)`, `Tests 13626 passed | 2 skipped (13628)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-gantt/ examples/schema-catalog/`: `Test Files 130 passed | 1 skipped (131)`, `Tests 2911 passed | 114 skipped (3025)`, VERDICT command-exit 0 (the skips are the zone-conditional `skipIf` pins). The second run holds every test that reads a markdown file this PR changes outside `packages/types` and `scripts` (`markdown-test-inputs.mjs` ledger), `readme-navigation-example.test.ts` among them.
- **Arm-list consumer sweep** (declared narrowing): 232 tracked test files outside `packages/types` and `packages/cli` that name `AnyComponentSchema`, `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema`, `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`, `ObjectQLComponentSchema`, `ObjectGanttBlockSchema`, `nodeOracles`, `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, `propsLevelOf`, `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, `unmirroredAlias`, `collectArms`, `getPublicConfigs`, `ComponentPropsMap`, `validateSchema` or `StrictAuthoringFace`, or reference `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `block-config-schema-parity`, `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `strict-authoring-face`, `zod-mirror-parity`, `objectql.zod`, `index.zod`, `ObjectGanttSchema`, `object-gantt` or `plugin-gantt`. Three chunks, at `ceead94ad` plus the two triage edits later committed byte-identical as `c572b020c`: `78 passed / 1 failed (79)` (the render-identity anti-vacuity row, then triaged), `73 passed / 1 failed (74)` (the catalog-plans pin, then triaged), and `79 passed` plus the two triaged files: `Test Files 81 passed (81) / Tests 1610 passed`, VERDICT 0. Later commits add the render pin, the docs and the changesets; their markdown readers are re-run in the final union above.
- **Build / type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`, VERDICT 0 (`dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (138 emitted files verified)`); the b6 pin is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s `--listFilesOnly`. After `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-gantt^...' --filter '@object-ui/example-schema-catalog^...' build` (VERDICT 0): `@object-ui/plugin-gantt type-check` and `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog type-check`, VERDICT 0 (the two plugin-gantt pins and the catalog render-identity pin are in their test programs).
- **Runtime ablation** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, two nested WRAP legs plus the driver's own EXIT/INT/TERM trap with an absolute path and a blob check): the flat arm restored, i.e. `ObjectGanttBlockSchema` out of the public-block union (anchor x1 to x0, blob `bc957ee9` to `8390b06a`) and `ObjectGanttSchema` back into `ObjectQLComponentSchema` (anchor x1 to x0, blob to `e5be71a8`; on disk `ObjectGanttBlockSchema,` x0 in the public union and `ObjectGanttSchema,` x1 in the ObjectQL union). Over 13 test files (the two new pins, the census and triaged files, the catalog pins and the objectui#10859 ratchet): `Tests 93 failed | 783 passed (876)`. Red: 78 b6 rows, 4 of 6939, 3 catalog validate rows, 2 of 9256, 2 of 10872, one each in 7363, b2 and 11070, and the render pin's validator row. Green: the census files whose subject is the export itself (`zod-mirror-parity`, `imported-defaults-8317`), the ratchet, the catalog-plans pin (a direct mount), every render row, and the 26 b6 rows that read the spec or the arm directly (the lit controls, the per-member page-component split, the row-by-reference row, the binding and channel refusals the flat arm shared, the spec-divergence row and the flat-mirror row). Direction red, as expected. Restored: blob == HEAD `bc957ee9`, `git diff HEAD` empty (both tool legs and the driver). Vitest aliases `@object-ui/types/zod` to source, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.
- **Type-level reverse validation** (same tool): the bag replaced by `z.strictObject({ objectName: z.string().optional() }).optional()` made `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2 with exactly one error, `TS2344: Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'` on the bag `Equal` row of the b6 pin. Restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Render** (committed pin, real registry, recording adapter): the bag queries `find('task', …)` with its own `$filter` and `$orderby` and hands the chart one task per row, titled by its `gantt` block; the two flat spellings a composer builds (the `gantt` block on the node, and the flattened `GanttConfig` keys) make the identical call and hand the chart identical tasks; a bag bound only through `dataSource` queries the bound object; a bag on inline rows draws them with no host query; control: a bag naming another object queries that object and never `task`. The catalog render-identity pin draws the three bag entries exactly as its recorded pre-repair DOM.

## Deviations

- **`label` is not refused flat.** The order asks for one `aliasKeyRefusal` per bag member. `label` is a row member AND a node-level key of the spec's own `PageComponentSchema` (its display label): measured, the spec's page component accepts `label` on an `object-gantt` node while it refuses every other row member written there. Refusing it would make objectui refuse a spec-valid document, so `label` keeps `BaseSchema`'s member. The pin re-derives the split from the installed spec for every row member, so a spec that moves it turns the pin red.
- **The flat mirror's `GanttConfig` members and `dependencyField` are refused by name on the bag arm**, beyond the row-key set: they were declared members of the flat mirror, and their bag home is the row's `gantt` block (batch 5's precedent for `locationField` / `titleField`). The key set is the row's own `gantt` member, read off the crossed row.
- **`search` / `searchableFields`** (flat-mirror members, absent from the row) are left undeclared on the bag arm, as batch 4 left the row-absent members of `object-form`: unjudged by the tolerant face, refused by the strict one, refused by the row inside the bag. A list view writes them onto the node it composes, which never meets these faces.
- **Second changeset**, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` patch: the README, and two test files under `src/`, which the presence gate counts as published source.
- **Comments this change made false, or that were already false next to the edit, corrected in passing:** `requireRecordSource`'s docblock said neither `object-map` nor `object-gantt` has a `ComponentPropsMap` row (both have had one since 17.5.0); the flat mirror's `gantt` member comment and the TypeScript twin's `gantt` comment said the mirror reaches `validate` through `AnyComponentSchema`; the `ObjectQLComponentSchema` docblock's opening sentence named two departed arms out of four.
- The harness attribution reminder asked for model-named commit trailers and a different PR footer. Per `AGENTS.md` and the role file, the commits carry the model-free pair and this body the session-URL footer.

## Acceptance notes

- **The bag follows the spec row, which is not the flat mirror.** Measured: the row types `markers` as an array of unknown and `navigation` as unknown, so `properties.markers: [{ date: 5 }]` and `properties.navigation: { mode: 'nope' }` parse, where the flat mirror refuses both (`invalid_type` at `markers.0.date`, `invalid_value` at `navigation.mode`). The row's own contract, taken by reference; no producer writes either.
- **The governed producer** `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` "Gantt plugin example" authors a flat `object-gantt` node (`objectName` and `gantt` on the node), which `objectui validate` refuses after this change, and its prose says the flat field keys may be written on the node. `check:skill-examples` exits 0 on it (it does not run `safeValidateSchema`). Per the answer's step 4 it goes through the governed path; batch 4 noted its `object-form` sibling on objectui#11183.
- The README's "A maximal node" carries `bind` on the node, which the spec's page component refuses (`unrecognized_keys ['bind']`) while objectui's `BaseSchema` declares it. The flat node at base carried the same key; unchanged here.
- **The sdui-parser html tier spells this node flat by design**, as batch 5 recorded for the other bag-armed blocks.
